policy: shipped dict28.c four-probe FIFO chains (evict tail when chain reaches PROBES=4)
lambda_rule: lambda_b = S / nb_total, nb_total = 2^63 shards x 2^63 buckets = 2^126 is the LARGEST power-of-two bucket count the shipped u64 field can hold (dict28_ws_init takes u64 nb and rejects non-powers-of-two; ws_bucket masks a 64-bit mix, so one level addresses <= 2^63 buckets).  v34's 2^128 is NOT representable and its lambda 0.2815 is withdrawn.

retention.delta_explanation: 1-P(Poisson(lambda)>=5) is the terminal-size limit for an insertion-only bucket; the shipped chain evicts during fill as well, so the measured loss is larger. Both are reported; the LOWER of the two is used.

kappa_detect.definition: P(true cross-trail key collision is DETECTED) = P(the earlier record is resident and the shipped dict28_wide_lookup returns its reference at the later arrival). Injected-collision control: uniformly chosen earlier key replayed through the shipped lookup.

wrong_lambda_control.note: the v34 lambda is not instantiable by the shipped u64 store (2^128 heads); the arm is not run there because no bucket count of that size can be initialised
